key_path: Sign up at app.pinecone.io (email/Google/GitHub/Microsoft), verify email
Agent path: `brew install pinecone-io/tap/pinecone` then `pc auth login` (browser URL, auto-targets org/project)
`pc api-key create` mints a project API key (or Console > API Keys > Create)

agent_native_auth.cli_browser_or_device_login: yes - `pc auth login` browser flow; token refreshes, valid up to 120 days; service-account auth for CI
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: no for the main Database MCP (API key in env); Nexus MCP is Streamable HTTP with API key/session token
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: yes - Admin API (service-account access token) and CLI `pc api-key create/list/update`; Terraform provider manages projects + keys; 'Connect to Pinecone' popup/widget lets third-party apps get a user's key
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: yes - project-scoped keys with roles (All / ReadOnly / control vs data plane)
agent_native_auth.test_credentials_sandbox: partial - Pinecone Local emulator (Docker) for offline testing

mcp.product_mcp_local: npx -y @pinecone-database/mcp (env PINECONE_API_KEY): docs search + index management, upsert, query
mcp.product_mcp_remote: Assistant MCP (managed remote endpoint per assistant, API key) and Nexus MCP (Streamable HTTP); no hosted OAuth MCP for Database
mcp.one_click: `claude plugin install pinecone`, Cursor `/add-plugin pinecone`, Codex plugin, `npx skills add pinecone-io/skills`

docs_for_agents.openapi: yes - OpenAPI specs section in llms.txt
docs_for_agents.agents_md_or_rules: yes - https://docs.pinecone.io/AGENTS-PYTHON.md and AGENTS-JAVASCRIPT.md; agent skills library

time_to_first_call_notes: Signup + email verify, then CLI login and key mint are agent-driven.
agent_friendliness_justification: Browser-login CLI that mints keys, Admin API/service accounts, published AGENTS.md files and plugins for every major agent; held back by a key-in-env local MCP with no hosted OAuth option.
best_practice: Published AGENTS-PYTHON.md / AGENTS-JAVASCRIPT.md at the docs root plus a 'Connect to Pinecone' embeddable flow that hands a user's API key to a third-party app.
biggest_gap: Main MCP is local npx with a raw API key; no remote OAuth MCP, so web agents (Claude.ai/ChatGPT) cannot connect without a pasted key.
